messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Use the tools when they help.
Find the directory named src in my home using a tool.

function.name: find_dir
function.description: Find directories under the user's home whose name contains the query. Names that look like secrets are left out and the result says so.

function.name: list_dir
function.description: List the entries of a directory under the user's home. Names that look like secrets are left out and the result says so.
